usedFor: humanitix holds events and ticket orders, and Documint fills a document through “Add Content To Template” for each “New Order”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in humanitix, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: Each ticket order fills a Documint template, giving you an order document without copying fields by hand.

watchOut: “New Order” carries only high level order information, while “New Attendes” carries each attendee's details.
